org.portico.utils

Class ObjectFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.ObjectFactory

  • public class ObjectFactory
extends Object
    The ObjectFactory class provides a couple of instance-creation convenience methods. These methods can take care of the process of instantiating an instance of a class from a given class name. The methods will also apply some validity checks to make sure the class is of the type you are expecting.

      • create

        public static <T> T create(String classname,
                           Class<T> targetClass)
                    throws ClassNotFoundException,
                           IllegalAccessException,
                           InstantiationException
        This method will dynamically create an instance of any given class name and will verify that it is of the given target class. The class loader used will be the one that loaded this class (ObjectFactory.class.getClassLoader()).
        Parameters:
        classname - Name of the class to instantiate
        targetClass - Class class to compare the generated instance to
        Returns:
        An instance of the class requested
        Throws:
        ClassNotFoundException
        IllegalAccessException
        InstantiationException

      • create

        public static <T> T create(Class<?> clazz,
                           Class<T> targetClass)
                    throws ClassNotFoundException,
                           IllegalAccessException,
                           InstantiationException
        This method is the same as create(String, Class) except that it takes the class you want to instantiate. This method essentially encapsulates all instantiation logic and post-instantiation checks, removing that burdern from the user.
        Throws:
        ClassNotFoundException
        IllegalAccessException
        InstantiationException

      • create

        public static <T> T create(String classname,
                           ClassLoader loader,
                           Class<T> targetClass)
                    throws ClassNotFoundException,
                           IllegalAccessException,
                           InstantiationException
        This method will dynamically create an instance of any given class name and will verify that it is of the given target class. The given class loader will be used to locate the class file
        Parameters:
        classname - The name of the class to instantiate
        loader - The loader to use to get the class
        targetClass - Type the created instance should be of (or a valid super type/interface)
        Returns:
        An instance of the given class name
        Throws:
        ClassNotFoundException
        IllegalAccessException
        InstantiationException
